key_insight: The paper makes operator learning self-explainable by decomposing predictions into localized integral contributions, revealing which input regions drive each output pattern.
engineering_relevance: This provides a transparent way to trust and diagnose data-driven models for fluid mechanics problems such as blood flow and unsteady aerodynamics.
method: Reformulate operator learning as a linear combination of generalized functional linear models.
Split the input domain into subdomains and compute localized integrals to measure regional importance.
Embed interpretability directly into the operator, avoiding separate post-hoc explainability tools.
evidence_signal: The framework is evaluated on function-to-scalar and function-to-function fluid-flow tasks, with explanations that align qualitatively with established post-hoc methods and often emphasize regions of strong feature gradients.
watch_item: Localization-based explanations may depend on how the domain is partitioned, so implementation choices could affect the granularity and stability of the interpreted regions.
paper_title: Self-explainable Operator Learning for Discovering Spatial Patterns in Functional Data
